metaTitle: Custom Full Color Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color lanyards and badges for your team. Dye sublimation ensures vibrant, lasting logos. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Full color lanyards and badges let you reproduce intricate logos, gradients, and photos with photographic clarity. Dye sublimation bonds the ink into polyester fabrics, so the design won't peel or fade—even after daily wear. Whether you need 3/4" polyester lanyards with retractable badge reels for a trade show or heavy weight satin lanyards for a corporate event, full color printing gives your brand a sharp, professional look that stands out.
heroAltText: Custom full color lanyards and badges with vibrant dye sublimated logo prints for corporate events and trade shows.
